verdict.rationale: Devin documents a public API for integrating and automating workflows, including creating sessions on behalf of org users. Its Devin MCP server also exposes session management, playbooks, knowledge and scheduling, which covers much of the core UI workflow programmatically. However, nothing claims or shows full UI parity, and interactive UI features (taking over in Devin's IDE, the Interactive Browser, watching the live terminal) have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage matrix, API equivalents for interactive IDE/browser/terminal features, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
